Electricity is already withdrawn from the plant bus. Production effects are in the physical trace; neither is charged again as purchased electricity or lost methane.
Service charge prorating does not simulate a preventive maintenance visit. Shared provision does not by itself model another site's demand.

performance.scope: Local Apple Silicon macOS, pinned Playwright Chromium, 30 successive edits per condition. First edit retained separately. first_edits.scope: Five fresh browser contexts; first edit after the page and fonts are ready. Already-loaded local server; distinct tilt inputs. No CPU/network throttling. Not a process-cold or field percentile.

performance.interpretation: All measured conditions meet the chosen 200 ms p95 interaction and 10 ms render targets. Five additional fresh-page first edits span 97.8–99.2 ms on the already-loaded 240-hour server. This does not establish process-cold, remote-network or arbitrary-archive performance. The page-load layout shift remains unaddressed.

exploratory_before.scope: Exploratory Chrome DevTools observations of the pre-change live app on this Mac, collected during the qualification session. Rounded values transcribed from tool responses; not a matched 240-hour baseline or a field percentile.
exploratory_before.page_load_cls_observation: The main contributor was the Gradio loading/ETA overlay, not the plant SVG; the later interaction trace had CLS 0.
exploratory_before.causal_limit: This observation motivated avoiding collapsed detail work. It is not an isolated measurement of either subsequent code change.

devtools_after.scope: One unthrottled local reload trace and one subsequent first-edit inspection; not field percentiles or a matched pre/post experiment.
devtools_after.remaining: Investigate and stabilise the initial loading shell without altering the reviewed plant artwork.
